summary: Backend testing for Qisas Al-Anbiya (Stories of the Prophets) API completed. All 18 pytest cases across 11 review requirements passed (100%). Verified: root count=25, chrono/alpha sorting, prophet detail with full schema (story/miracles/lessons/youtube_query/kids_story), 404 on missing id, miracle-of-the-day with today's ISO date, deterministic story-of-the-day, kids stories (25 items) and quizzes (10 items with valid answer indices), bookmarks upsert/idempotency/list/delete flow (no _id leaks), and Emergent OpenAI TTS generation with caching, MP3 serving via GET /api/tts/{key}.mp3 (Content-Type audio/mpeg, 13KB > 5KB threshold). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loads correctly from /app/backend/.env.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') handler. Should migrate to lifespan context manager (FastAPI 0.93+). Non-blocking; app functions correctly.
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api_router). Works currently but Starlette recommends adding middleware before routes for consistent behavior.

action_items: (Optional/Minor) Replace deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan context manager in /app/backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: Bookmarks list query correctly projects out _id ({"_id": 0}) — no ObjectId serialization leak.
TTS cache key derived from sha256(text|voice|speed|model|format) — deterministic and safe.
Prophet detail 404 handled correctly via HTTPException.
TTS max text length clamped to 4000 (OpenAI TTS caps at 4096) — good.
server.py at 260 lines — well below 700-line threshold; single-file backend is acceptable for this MVP.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) read from environment, no hardcoded values.
seed_data_creation: None. Bookmarks tests use TEST_-prefixed random device_id and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend testing scaffold present at /app/backend/tests/. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Uses http://localhost:8001 (override with BACKEND_TEST_URL env var). TTS test relies on emergentintegrations OpenAI TTS via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — first call may take a few seconds; subsequent calls hit the file cache in /app/backend/audio_cache/. Deleting cache dir will exercise the fresh generation path again.
rca_of_issue: No issues to RCA — all requested endpoints behave as specified.
